quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary and CFO Li Guanghua (Hubei listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing): downstream module makers' shipments recovered quarter on quarter in Q2 and the company's matching shipments rose, with scale effects supporting profit while expansion-related fixed costs continue. The tight supply-demand it described applies mainly to optical isolators and communication filters, whose orders are full on strong compute demand, with upstream raw-material supply at times affecting delivery pace; consumer electronics is structurally stable. Securities representative Hu Yulan said selling prices are currently held steady, the company giving priority to long-term customer relationships, with future pricing to reflect costs. The phone micro-prism line has not yet produced scaled revenue, and the communications optics share of revenue keeps rising in 2026.
